name: APEX Free AI Media Stack
purpose: Launchpad for free/zero-cost AI image, video, caption, editing and ad-creative tools. Credit amounts and rights are tracked as evidence, not assumptions.
rules: Free access is not automatically commercial permission.
Record the exact plan, allowance, watermark state and rights before publishing a commercial asset.
Account-dependent promotions are marked VERIFY rather than treated as guaranteed.
Never put API keys, passwords or session tokens in this repository.

tools.name: ImagesArt.ai
tools.commercial: yes — pricing page lists commercial license

tools.name: ImagineArt
tools.free: 100 daily credits; free tier lists 3,000 credits/month
tools.commercial: verify current plan/terms before paid advertising

tools.name: Pika
tools.commercial: no on Basic/free according to Pika FAQ/terms

tools.name: Runway
tools.commercial: verify current free-plan rights before commercial use

tools.name: Canva Free
tools.free: up to 20 Standard or Premium AI uses; 5GB storage
tools.watermark: free/owned content can export cleanly; Pro content has restrictions
tools.commercial: Canva license permits advertising/promotional projects subject to content-specific restrictions

tools.name: Adobe Express Free
tools.free: 2 lifetime 5-second Generate Video uses; free daily generations for some image features

tools.name: HeyGen Free
tools.free: 3 videos/month, up to 1 minute; regional limits can vary
tools.watermark: free plan does not include watermark removal
tools.commercial: verify current plan terms before commercial publishing

tools.name: Formats
tools.free: 10 one-time credits / about 5 minutes AI captions

tools.name: ImgAI
tools.free: 10 images/day on free models without signup; 50 signup credits; 5–30 daily check-in credits
tools.commercial: possible subject to selected model/provider terms

tools.name: CapCut
tools.free: free editor plus free commercial-use templates; AI allowances vary by feature/account
tools.commercial: commercial-use template collection exists; check each asset's license

tools.name: Luma Dream Machine
tools.free: limited free web generations/credits; current allowance is account-dependent
tools.watermark: free web output may be watermarked
tools.commercial: free web use should be treated as non-commercial unless current plan terms say otherwise

tools.name: Artiroom
tools.commercial: commercial license is not included on the free tier according to current pricing
